title: Exact Finite-Channel Schur Moments of the Wigner-Smith Matrix with a Tunnel Barrier
summary: We consider the Wigner--Smith time-delay matrix of a chaotic cavity with broken time-reversal symmetry, a finite number $M$ of equivalent open channels, and a uniform tunnel barrier of reflection probability $R$. Exact random-matrix results for nonideal coupling are known at the level of the joint matrix distribution, whereas explicit finite-channel formulas for Schur moments are much less developed. We show that every Schur moment of the nonideal Wigner--Smith matrix factorizes into its ideal-coupling inverse-Laguerre value and a barrier factor given by a circular unitary ensemble (CUE)…
